verdicts.item:
2. An access request text with markup is shown as text.
   Shows A19-1. [witness: verification:registry_a19_access_request_markup_shown_as_text]
statements:
```text
render(v) = escape(v) for every stored value v   -- A19-1
no stored value is ever evaluated or executed   -- A19-2
```
quotes: assert [i["request_text"] for i in items] == [ACCESS_MARKUP]  # stored as given
assert "img" not in page.tags and "zb" not in page.tags
assert all(name not in ("onerror", "src") for _, name, _ in page.attributes)
verdicts.why: The check proves this particular access-request value is stored unchanged, appears as text, and does not become the supplied elements or attributes. It does not establish render(v) = escape(v) for every stored value, nor universally prove that no stored value is ever evaluated or executed.
